# HowToCalculate.app

> > Practical calculators and guides for finance, mortgages, investments, business metrics, and everyday math — built for informed decision-making.

HowToCalculate.app provides interactive calculators and educational content covering personal finance (mortgage payments, compound interest, salary conversion), business analytics (churn rates), science and math (triangle geometry, density, pressure), and practical tools (time tracking, unit conversion). The site emphasizes real-world applications with detailed guides on PITI, DTI, PMI, amortization, and retirement planning.

## Key Topics

- Mortgage Calculator & PITI Analysis
- PMI (Private Mortgage Insurance)
- DTI (Debt-to-Income Ratio)
- Compound Interest & Wealth Building
- Amortization Schedules
- Home Affordability & Down Payment Impact
- APR vs APY & Interest Rates
- Retirement Planning & Real Returns
- Triangle Geometry (SSS, SAS, ASA, AAS, SSA)
- Unit Conversion Tools
- SaaS Churn Rate Metrics
- Salary & Budget Planning
- Investment Growth Calculators
- HOA (Homeowners Association) Costs

## Finance & Mortgage Calculators

- [Mortgage Calculator: Home Loan Analysis](https://howtocalculate.app/finance/mortgage-calculator): Calculate mortgage payments, amortization, PMI, HOA, and total interest
- [Compound Interest Calculator: Wealth Building Guide](https://howtocalculate.app/finance/compound-interest-calculator): Project investment returns with compound interest and monthly contributions
- [Salary Calculator: Hourly to Annual Pay Converter](https://howtocalculate.app/finance/salary-calculator): Convert salary between hourly, weekly, monthly, and annual rates
- [Car Insurance Calculator: Smart Coverage Guide](https://howtocalculate.app/finance/car-insurance-calculator): Estimate car insurance premiums with coverage options and deductibles

## Financial Planning & Strategy Guides

- [Mortgage Calculator: First-Time Buyer Guide](https://howtocalculate.app/blog/ultimate-mortgage-calculator-guide): First-time buyer guide covering PITI, PMI, HOA, and DTI calculations
- [APR vs APY vs Nominal vs Effective Rate (and the 3 Traps I See Most)](https://howtocalculate.app/blog/apr-vs-apy-nominal-effective): APR vs APY explained with compounding and loan comparison strategies
- [PITI + DTI: The Affordability Math That Keeps You From Becoming House-Poor](https://howtocalculate.app/blog/piti-dti-affordability-guide): PITI, DTI, HOA guide with +1% stress test for home affordability decisions
- [From Salary to a Budget That Works: A Simple Monthly System](https://howtocalculate.app/blog/salary-to-budget-framework): Four-bucket budgeting system for salary conversion and monthly planning
- [Inflation and Real Returns: The Retirement Math People Skip](https://howtocalculate.app/blog/inflation-real-returns-retirement): Real vs nominal returns analysis with retirement scenario testing

## Business & Analytics Tools

- [Monthly Churn Rate Calculator: Calculate Customer Loss Rate](https://howtocalculate.app/business/monthly-churn-rate-calculator): Calculate SaaS monthly churn rate and customer retention metrics

## Math & Science Calculators

- [Triangle Calculator: SSS, SAS, ASA, AAS, SSA Solutions](https://howtocalculate.app/math/triangle-calculator): Solve triangles using SSS, SAS, ASA, AAS, SSA with trigonometry formulas
- [Pressure Calculator: Convert Between Units - Bar, PSI, Pascal, ATM](https://howtocalculate.app/science/pressure-calculator): Convert pressure between bar, PSI, Pascal, and atmosphere units
- [Density Calculator: Mass, Volume & Density](https://howtocalculate.app/science/density-calculator): Calculate density, mass, or volume using SI physics formulas

## Home & Environmental Calculators

- [Solar Panel ROI Calculator: Payback Period & Savings Analysis](https://howtocalculate.app/environmental/solar-panel-roi-calculator): Calculate solar ROI, payback period with ITC and net metering analysis
- [Roofing Shingle Calculator: Material Estimation](https://howtocalculate.app/home/roofing-shingle-calculator): Estimate roofing shingles, bundles, and material costs for roof projects

## Health & Lifestyle Guides

- [Protein Intake Calculator: Master Your Muscle Building and Recovery](https://howtocalculate.app/blog/protein-intake-calculator-mastery-guide): Optimize protein intake for muscle growth and body composition goals

## Utility & Conversion Tools

- [Day Counter Calculator: Count Days Between Dates & Events](https://howtocalculate.app/time/day-counter-calculator): Count days between dates using Gregorian calendar with UTC precision
- [Hours Calculator: Calculate Work Hours & Time Duration](https://howtocalculate.app/other/hours-calculator): Calculate work hours with break deductions for payroll and billing
- [Weight Converter: Mass and Weight Conversion Guide](https://howtocalculate.app/conversion/weight-converter): Convert weight between metric and imperial units (kg, lbs, oz, grams)
- [Password Generator: Secure & Strong Passwords](https://howtocalculate.app/technology/password-generator): Generate cryptographically secure passwords with custom entropy settings
